typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		TRADE_ID as decimal(38,0),
		TRADE_STATUS as string,
		PRODUCT_TYPE as string,
		BOOK_NAME as string,
		BOOK_ID as decimal(38,0),
		CLEARINGCHANNEL as string,
		ECN_SOURCE as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource derive(loadDate = currentTimestamp()) ~> DerivedColumn2
DerivedColumn2 sink(input(
		clearingChannel as string,
		tradeStatus as string,
		bookName as string,
		ecnSource as string,
		loadDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		tradeId as string,
		productType as string,
		bookId as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		clearingChannel = CLEARINGCHANNEL,
		tradeStatus = TRADE_STATUS,
		bookName = BOOK_NAME,
		ecnSource = ECN_SOURCE,
		loadDate,
		tradeId = TRADE_ID,
		productType = PRODUCT_TYPE,
		bookId = BOOK_ID),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
